title: GenFair: Systematic Test Generation for Fairness Fault Detection in Large Language Models
findings: The paper does not provide specific quantitative findings for religion alone. The key finding is that the proposed method, GenFair, demonstrates a higher Fault Detection Rate (FDR) for fairness violations in general—which includes religious attributes—compared to template-based and ASTRAEA-based approaches across both GPT-4.0 and LLaMA 3.0 models.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures tone-based fairness violations related to religious attributes. It systematically generates test cases with different religious identifiers and compares the tone of the Large Language Model's responses to detect biases and inconsistencies.
